paragraphs.text: Vial Smasher is a legendary goblin berserker from Tarkir . In Tarkir's original timeline, she was known as Yasimin Ankleshank , and by the war-name Ankle Shanker .

In the original timeline, with another name, the Planeswalker Sarkhan Vol had considered her a clan-mate in the Mardu Horde and a friend. In that timeline, she had been known as Yasimin Ankleshank, or Ankle Shanker.

The denizens of Tarkir know well the destructive power of dragonfire, and Vial Smasher, a goblin of the Kolaghan clan, is no exception. Brash and fearless, she has spent a lifetime handling — and smashing — vials of this dangerous substance.
Vial Smasher made her way to Thunder Junction through an Omenpath between 4562 and c. 4563 AR , where she became a member of Akul 's Hellspurs .
